name: motion-haleness
description: A modern, high-contrast dark color theme for Visual Studio Code, optimized for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Kilo Code.

editor.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the editor. Motion Haleness bundles Inconsolata; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.

editor.fontSize.description: Font size in the editor. Inconsolata renders smaller than most monospace fonts, so Motion Haleness defaults to 15.

editor.fontWeight.description: Font weight used in the editor. Inconsolata is a variable font (200-900); 400 keeps the code readable without being too thin.

terminal.integrated.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the integrated terminal. Motion Haleness bundles Inconsolata; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.

terminal.integrated.fontWeight.description: Font weight used in the integrated terminal. Inconsolata is a variable font (200-900); 400 keeps terminal output readable without being too thin.

terminal.integrated.fontSize.description: Font size in the integrated terminal. Inconsolata renders smaller than most monospace fonts, so Motion Haleness defaults to 15.

markdown.preview.fontFamily.description: Font family used in the Markdown preview. Motion Haleness bundles Inconsolata; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.
